findings.current: Hwangbo Eom’s face had gone pale from his Internal Injury.
findings.defect: “Internal Injury” is capitalized like a formal System status even though it appears in ordinary narration and is rendered in lowercase elsewhere in the packet.
findings.rationale: Lowercase matches the term's ordinary narrative use and removes an isolated formatting inconsistency.
findings.replacement: Hwangbo Eom’s face had gone pale from his internal injury.

summary: The packet is coherent and preserves its major hooks, character voices, and System formatting. Three actionable issues remain: one established-title drift, one contradictory first-person reference, and one capitalization inconsistency.
